text: SoftBank recorded a $4.2B quarterly gain on its OpenAI stake, helping deliver a ¥248.6B net profit and a $2.4B Vision Fund gain despite losses in Coupang, Didi, and a ByteDance markdown. The firm said ~60% of assets are now "ASI-oriented," created an AI Computing Segment including Arm, and continued reallocating capital toward AI while trimming other holdings.

meta.note: Valuation-driven gains offset operating losses in new AI segment.

text: GDP rose 0.1% in Q4, below expectations and matching Q3's pace. December output grew 0.1% m/m as services showed no growth, manufacturing provided the main support, and construction logged its weakest performance in over four years. Full-year 2025 growth was estimated at 1.3%. The Bank of England held rates at 3.75% amid persistent inflation pressures.

The Trump administration announced the end of "Operation Metro Surge" in Minnesota after deploying thousands of ICE and CBP officers since December. A prior 700-agent drawdown continues, with a reduced "small footprint" remaining temporarily as control transitions back to a local field office. State leaders publicly split in their assessments of the operation's impact.

meta.note: Operational success claims conflict with state-level criticism.

text: January existing home sales fell 8.4% m/m to a 3.91M annualized pace, down 4.4% y/y. Inventory totaled 1.22M units (3.7-month supply), below a balanced six-month level, while the median price rose 0.9% y/y to $396,800, a record for January. Sales declined most in lower price tiers and in the South and West; homes averaged 46 days on market.

meta.note: Price resilience contrasts with volume contraction.

text: A U.S. District Court judge issued a preliminary injunction blocking Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth from censuring Sen. Mark Kelly, reducing his retired Navy rank, or cutting retirement pay over a video about refusing illegal orders. The court found Kelly likely to succeed on First Amendment grounds and rejected arguments that military discipline doctrines or internal appeals bar judicial review.

meta.note: Judicial authority directly counters executive disciplinary action.

text: The EPA formally revoked the Clean Air Act endangerment finding that classified greenhouse gases as threats to public health, eliminating associated vehicle emissions standards and dismantling the regulatory basis established after the 2007 Supreme Court ruling. The action removes the legal foundation for federal carbon limits across autos, power plants, and oil and gas facilities, prompting immediate political and legal opposition.

meta.note: Administrative reversal directly confronts prior Supreme Court interpretation.
